main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on forecast, profile bars
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check), <= -2 rejects

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the mean excess next-day return over forecast>0 bars is above 0.
reading: Profile bars are those where the strategy's regime was active (component recorded, regime not 'chop'); the coin's mean is the mean 1-day return over all its windows; the slope t uses day-clustered standard errors (CR1 correction); minimum counts are taken over profile bars with forecast above 0 and a next-day return inside the window.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0003207 on the check folds against +0.0006362 on every fold
